page: Microsoft Azure E32-8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring a constrained core configuration. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor based on the x86_64 architecture, offering 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core running at 4.5 GHz. The CPU features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside instruction support for AVX-512 vector extensions, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic operations. The instance is provisioned with 256.0 GB of memory, yielding 32.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, and includes 1890 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage without attached GPUs.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded CPU capability alongside modest parallel throughput. In stress-ng single-core tests, the instance reached 3779.98, placing it in the top 10% tier, mirrored by top-tier single-threaded gzip compression at 41.23 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 18.42 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core stress-ng performance scored 15115.85 and PassMark CPU registered 18926.2, falling within the middle 50% band due to the 8-vCPU constraint. Memory testing registered 49.32 GB/sec read and 33.98 GB/sec write bandwidth on large 256 MB blocks, while PassMark database operations scored 5324.15 and Redis SET throughput achieved 14.91 million operations per second.

The constrained vCPU allocation paired with 256.0 GB of RAM and local NVMe storage provides a cost-efficient hardware profile for workloads constrained by per-core software licensing. Rather than paying core licenses for a 32-core footprint, applications access large memory capacity and fast scratch storage with only 8 licensed vCPUs. The primary architectural tradeoff is lower overall multi-threaded throughput and reduced prompt processing in larger language models, such as the 31.4 tokens per second observed on 7B parameter models.

Microsoft Azure E32-8ads_v7 is tailored for memory-intensive and licensed enterprise workloads. It suits in-memory caches, relational database systems such as SQL Server or Oracle requiring heavy RAM footprints per licensed core, large-scale Redis deployments, and memory-bound ETL data pipelines needing fast local NVMe swap and intermediate storage.
description: Microsoft Azure E32-8ads_v7 is a memory-optimized instance engineered for applications requiring high memory density with constrained core counts. Powered by a 4.5 GHz AMD EPYC 9V45 processor, it allocates 8 dedicated vCPUs (4 physical cores) with AVX-512 capabilities, 256.0 GB of system memory, and 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage without discrete GPUs. The configuration delivers 32.0 GB of memory per vCPU and excels in single-threaded compute, scoring in the top 10% for single-core stress-ng tests and compression routines. While aggregate multi-threaded capacity reflects its 8-vCPU ceiling, its large RAM pool and bundled fast NVMe storage make it highly cost-effective for core-licensed relational databases, large-scale Redis in-memory caches, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
